verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published or reproducible accuracy benchmarks. The only support for the second half of the story is indirect: a 10,000-free-page tier and a 5-minute Python/API quickstart would let an engineer process their own documents and evaluate the output before committing. Missing for 10: published accuracy benchmarks, reproducible benchmark methodology/datasets, first-party eval tooling or scoring guidance, independent corroboration of parse accuracy.
